content.short: GetBlock provides RPC nodes and blockchain APIs that help developers connect apps, wallets, and services to supported networks.
content.description: GetBlock is an infrastructure provider that gives developers and businesses access to shared and dedicated blockchain nodes through ready to use RPC endpoints and APIs. Its official docs position the service around fast endpoint setup, access tokens, multi chain coverage, and managed connectivity so teams can build without running their own node stack. The platform supports more than 100 networks and includes TON specific JSON RPC endpoints, which makes it practical for wallets, analytics products, DeFi apps, and other services that need reliable chain access.
content.meta: GetBlock provides RPC nodes and blockchain APIs for developers building wallets, apps, and services across supported networks.
